Title: Public preview: Listener TLS certificates management available in the Azure portal

Body.Content:
Azure Application Gateway is a Layer-7 load balancer that enables scalable, highly available, and secure web application delivery. To secure the backend workloads, one of its essential features is Transport Layer Security (TLS) termination, for which you can upload a TLS server certificate to a listener. The number of TLS certificates to manage can grow for large gateways with multiple HTTPS listeners.

Based on customer feedback that managing multiple TLS certificates could be time-consuming, we have introduced the Listener TLS certificates management section in Azure portal. This new portal section lets you easily list and manage all the listeners' certificates, which was earlier limited to Azure PowerShell or Azure CLI.

There will be more management capabilities coming to this section soon.

Learn more.
